qt: to the Commission Moritz Körner (Renew) Subject:

The Commission has failed to answer the specific questions raised in parliamentary question E002751/20231. The Commission is therefore asked to directly answer the following question: Commissioner Ylva Johansson stated on behalf of the Commission in response to parliamentary question E-001685/20232 that it is Commission policy not to comment on press articles. On what internal rule is this policy based and who decided on this rule?
